Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02180] Operation
Read the Status of an operation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a SOVD method
Read the Status of an operation
is received and, if
needed, the
proximity_challenge validation
according to [SWS_DM_02173]
succeeded, the DM shall call
SovdOperationExecution::GetStatus
of the
Sov-
dOperationExecution
assigned to the
execution-id
[SWS_DM_02177] of the
request body.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02181] Operation status
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If the DM instance has received the SOVD method
Read the Status of an
operation
and the
SovdOperationExecution::GetStatus
method has suc-
ceeded, the DM shall send a response body according to ASAM SOVD[5][14] with
the attributes:
status
set to value, derived from
SovdOperationExecution::GetStatus
(ob-
tained from returned GetStatusResponse.status),
capbaility
set to
execute
,
parameters
set to values, derived from the
DiagnosticSovdContentData
(via
GetStatusResponse.Parameters).
⌋
7.3.3.5.6 SOVD API – Modes
